selected_traces.name: Training buys practical help, then actual craft changes a companion
prerequisites: Father alive; preceding solo training cleared, Rank10/20/30/40 gates; last talk and Repairsmith agreement required for invitation.
decision: Train first, pay subsequent Father conversations, invite him, then fund and fit a crafted arm.
cost_and_time: Training unlock costs100/150/200/250Destiny. H conversations2000+2100+2200Destiny; invitation2300. Arm route7000+7500Destiny,10Mithril+30MP, then actual arm+8000Destiny. Combat completion time not fixed by the table; no live campaign timing measured.
mutations: First clears grant action regeneration; final conversations grant HabitEfficiency and Destiny capacity; invite makes npcD available; arm crafting removes npcD, fitting makes npcD2 available.
downstream_consumers: Changed companion stamina/element/Destiny stats and attack data; MainFlag hasFather; ChronicleE guide among other actor/gem requirements.
failure_and_aftermath: Failure/noncompletion blocks later conversations; father-dead flag blocks the chain. Accompaniment availability is distinct from allocating an occupied party slot.
limits: No live father fight or full damage/save behavior. ChronicleE actual ending gate is separate finale-branch predicate. Data locators:pathID60records26–29,115records65–82/1931–1934,83records8–9,99record13.

selected_traces.name: Early career commitment versus costly Elemental Master alternative
prerequisites: Elemental unlocks, sequential lessons and Rank50; four fifth lessons; earlier careers and Elemental Master mutually exclude each other.
decision: Take Rank35 career power earlier, or invest130units per element and5000Destiny into later specialization; choose spirit-root intervention.
cost_and_time: Early career costs2300/2700Destiny; final root spell30each of four elements. Learning boosts capacity/regeneration routine speed. Later fights/actions still required; no fabricated minutes.
mutations: Title/capacity/regeneration and mutually locked routes; spirit intervention locks sword/gem substitutes and reveals a weakened encounter.
downstream_consumers: Weakened Demon King, aftermath and later Mutant/castle steps feed endingD; specialization supplies a specific alternative rather than universal power.
failure_and_aftermath: Earlier career choice closes specialist route; unprepared capacity or missing lessons cannot pay root magic; later combat still needs success.
limits: Source narrative resurrection statement is not a separately observed revival simulation. pathID130records9–12;115records17–23/1057–1076/2033–2040/2081/2087–2093;60records18–19.

selected_traces.name: Eight route guides, explicit terminal predicates and differentiated clear rewards
prerequisites: Guide flags/restrictions, actual current UpgradeAction prerequisites, supplementary flow dependencies and Pride restriction where authored remain distinct.
decision: Choose committed departure/career/companion/Justice-or-Destiny/help/sword/gem/spirit branches; complete one authored ending action.
cost_and_time: Taking Norn50Destiny+2sandwiches+40firewood; leaving-alone branch requires1700Destiny refusal then2000Destiny+1sandwich+20firewood. Terminal ending rows have no extra Cost; prior branch expenditure remains real. Every main Chronicle MaxClearNum5.
mutations: Branches lock alternatives; school enrollment consumes200Gold and removes companion availability; endings declare ClearChronicle, achievement and reincarnation unlock.
downstream_consumers: Eight guide rows; terminal predicates reviewed by root; first/each/full-clear bonuses differ and feed capacity/regeneration/title/ritual/currency/queue-slot consumers. Chronicle.PayReward guards paid count against current/max count, CalculateAllReward selects each/first/max groups.
failure_and_aftermath: A guide list alone does not prove an ending can be clicked. Source endings A/B/C/F final predicates are now inspected, but preceding complete route/flow choreography remains unread. Reward persistence/rollback not tested.
limits: Terminal condition/effect rows alone do not prove all preceding campaigns. See ROOT_REVIEW ending records and Chronicle selected native bonus groups; most story actions unreviewed.

selected_traces.name: Ordinary medicine reaches a costly late rescue decision
prerequisites: Specific C7 aftermath; available medicine and discovered production materials. Treatment choices mutually exclude one another.
decision: Use ordinary Potion, HolyWater, a costly Elixir, or the no-supply option; accept distinct aftermath.
cost_and_time: Medicine4Herb/duration4; Potion6Water+3Medicine/duration10. Elixir baseDuration40, initial25MP+50SpiritWater+10DragonClaw+6Mandragora+5Potion+5HolyWater+1GoddessBlessing, progress1Action, output1. Effective time depends on speed; no live measurement.
mutations: Treatment consumes chosen stock. Potion/HolyWater fail and later text records death; Elixir heals body but leaves unconscious, unlocks evacuation and paid family/OldWoman scenes.
downstream_consumers: Earlier gathering/crafting feeds an earned less terminal narrative alternative; retained later dialogue reflects actual choice, not a free retry.
failure_and_aftermath: No-treatment available only without the three relevant supplies; failed medicine is spent; Elixir is not evidence of full cure or later rejoining.
limits: Selected native OnClick and typed data support costs/locks; full battle, medical-stat simulation and later cure remain unread. pathID88record8 and80records222–231.

selected_traces.name: Habit allocation earns class points, shallow retention and renewed class speed
prerequisites: Routine must be released, pass CanAllocateAgentList and restrictions. Routine.Requires also accepts a saved unlocked_ability flag or its require-condition list. Story acquisition of class-school access is outside this leaf review.
Unused Habit must be positive. HabitPlus_Click.IsMet checks remaining Habit; the Plus helper returns without change when none remain and clips requested allocation to available amount.
decision: Allocate scarce Habit to an available Warrior routine instead of another routine; manual and automatic assignments sum into actual AgentNum.
Wait and train through repeated completions; decide when to Dark Ritual rather than assuming every trained level is permanent.
cost_and_time: Allocated Habit is unavailable to other routines until reassigned; ApplyRemain recomputes cap minus summed allocations.

Warrior1=RoutineKind101 uses an interval parameter50 progress units, awards warriorPoint=ResourceKind111 with value1 per completion, and uses linear cost factor parameters0,1,0. Actual completion time depends on allocated Habit, HabitEfficiency and routine-specific multiplier; no live timeline measured.

GetProgress divides power by30 per online call, pays/checks cost when not already Paid, advances CurrentExp only on its permitted branch, gives the completion effect at interval, calls SliderFullAction and clears current progress/Paid. Installed Help documents a30 completions/sec maximum.
mutations: SliderFullAction increments run-local Level in SaveR.levels_ability and PermanentLevel in Save.levels_ability, then executes the authored slider-max callback list.
ClassRoutine.Talent = P/(P+100000)+0.1*S, where P is the current class-point resource and S is the run-local accumulated class sum. DarkRitualFactor returns this talent component.
On shallow reset, ClassRoutineContainer adds P/(P+100000) to class sum and zeroes class-point resource. WarriorAbility.ValueSum is SaveR.warrior_ability_sum0x140.

Each Class_Routine.AddSumLevel adds min(current Level,10000) to SaveR.subLevels_ability[kind], clamping0..100000. It does this before Habit_Routine.AscendedAction resets current level/progress when ToResetAfterAscend is true.
downstream_consumers: Class_Routine.Power multiplies base habit power by1+SumLevel/100000, giving at most+10 percentage points of proficiency per shallow reset and+100% overall. The cap is native-verified, not merely copied from Help.

The selected StatsFactorRegister callback b__0_62 returns1+Warrior.DarkRitualFactor; AscendCtrl.GetTalent consumes the assembled DarkRitual stats multiplicative result. The exact full parent stats-registration entry is not exhaustively traced.

Persistent routine completion counts are distinct from retained proficiency. Root separately reviewed AhaContentsList275-346: PermanentLevel<=0 excludes the routine from its list. This leaf confirms the producer and persistent field, not the AHA list consumer itself.
failure_and_aftermath: No unused Habit produces no allocation. Restricted/unreleased routines fail their allocation eligibility predicate; the complete UI wiring of all restriction owners is not audited here.

Extra current level above10000 contributes no additional proficiency at that shallow reset; accumulated proficiency above100000 is clamped. Extra Habit beyond the documented fill cap has no further rate effect.

Class-point sums and proficiency belong to SaveR, so they survive Dark Ritual but are discarded by the inspected deep SaveR replacement. Permanent completion records live in Save and are a different retained carrier.

selected_traces.name: Dark Ritual refreshes routine/rank growth without replacing campaign state
prerequisites: AscendCtrl.Available requires DarkRitualIsRestricted=false and saved timeFromLastAscend>=3600 seconds. DoShallowAscend checks this first and returns before reset when false. This is a real source timer, not a guessed campaign timeline.
decision: Perform the shallow ritual when available, selecting a tradeoff between current trained/rank power and the currently earned next talent.
cost_and_time: One-hour minimum native timer; many rates and next-talent factors can change what is earned during that hour. No exact travel/story duration is inferred.

Installed Help documents rank reset to0 and basic routine levels reset to0 except Energy. Native Habit_Routine reset is controlled per routine by ToResetAfterAscend; the Energy master-data flag itself was not independently checked here.
mutations: The method runs beforeAscendActionList callbacks, then sets Save.talentFactor0x618 to GetTalent rather than adding to existing talent, and resets timeFromLastAscend0x30.

It adds current Exp resource to saved exp_sum_in_one__reincarnation0x7F8 and exp_sum_in_this_run0x800 before zeroing the current Exp resource, then calls JudgeSacredRitual.JudgeRank and Will_Information.AscendedAction.

It runs the normal ascendActionList, clears manual/automatic Habit allocation arrays in SaveR at0x120/0x128, calls HabitCtrl.ApplyRemain, clears SaveR.clearedInThisLoop_Dungeon, increments darkritual_num, and resets gainedInspirations.
It runs afterAscendActionList and finally recalculates level effects. No new SaveR object or scene reload occurs inside DoShallowAscend.
downstream_consumers: Registered HabitRoutineController routines receive the shallow action; class routines retain the proficiency/saturating class-sum benefits described in YC-R01.

Habit.AscendedAction caches log(talentFactor+99,base100) for its breakdown; native constants are verified from the pinned x86_64 slice. Exact complete Habit stat-registration topology remains partial.
GetTalent reads DarkRitual stats and its multiplicative summary. Thus earned routine/capability factors can affect the next ritual, but raw method declarations alone are not evidence of that result.
failure_and_aftermath: Unavailable/hardmode-restricted ritual returns before mutation. Current talent can become lower if the chosen GetTalent result is lower, since the native operation replaces it.

The installed Help describes campaign continuity, while native evidence establishes the narrow owner preservation: the same Save and SaveR survive. This does not certify every quest or action callback.

Before/normal/after callback registration order is dynamic; only the routine/class/Habit-related chosen joins are reviewed. Guardian-kill and other callbacks exist, and complete rollback/exception behavior is unreviewed.

selected_traces.name: Reincarnation preserves selected ordinary progress and can retain costly marks
prerequisites: The inspected execute control installs ReservedHardmodeToNextChronicle_Restriction and shows a confirmation. Its affirmative callback calls DoDeepAscend. Narrative unlock of the Reincarnation UI and all hardmode restrictions are outside this leaf review.
decision: Confirm a new run, accepting the lost run-local work in exchange for computed Sin and retained cross-run systems.
cost_and_time: Most run-local progression and non-carryover current resources are lost. Exact source timer prerequisite for deep reset was not found in this selected path; do not reuse the one-hour shallow-ritual timer as its prerequisite.

ExpSum reads saved exp_sum_in_one__reincarnation plus current Exp; the selected reward path uses that accumulated value and the assembled factor_to_sin, with truncation on the executed path. Exact complete reward-factor sources were not exhaustively audited.
mutations: DoDeepAscend first runs _beforeReincarnationActions, briefly sets timeScale0, adds CanGetSin(true) to the Sin resource, adds current Exp to the persistent accumulated Exp field, and zeroes exp_sum_in_this_run.

It invokes selected hardmode transition, assigns starting talent from stats, resets shallow/deep timers, stores current time, selects current Chronicle, clears cleared_chronicle_in_this_run and resets resources.

ResetResource loops known resource IDs. IsCarryOverResources returns false if no UI master data exists; otherwise it invokes IResourceMasterData.ToCarryOver. A false result calls IResource.SetValue(0).

It sets toInitialize_reincarnation, toSkipOfflineBonusAfterReincarnation and toSkipDiffOfflineBonusAfterReincarnation true, removes accompanying obtained allies on a selected condition branch, clears selected Gluttony/Greed/Will/Envy run fields, then invokes SaveManager.DeepAscend.
SaveManager.DeepAscend invokes the reset-request handler, preserves the current Save in the selected main static slot, assigns a new SaveR, recalculates level effects, and disposes/reloads the scene.
downstream_consumers: SaveR contains rank, run-local routine levels/proficiency/class sums, run-local action/dungeon releases and temporary quest multipliers. The new SaveR provides the broad reset boundary; deep callbacks and later initialization may add exceptions.

Persistent Save contains routine PermanentLevel and retained upgrade clear counts. DecideParameter.Initialize calls _InitializeAfterReincarnation; with toInitialize_reincarnation and enabled_inheritance_of_classRoutine it checks retained warrior_school79/sorcerer_school80/tamer_school81 completion counts and releases class elements30/31/32 plus skill_party15. It then clears the initialization flag. This reopens class access without copying the inspected proficiency or class sums.

Reviewed installed resource rows carry ShouldCarryOver=true for inspiration, sin, sin_gluttony, ePoint1, ePoint2, ePoint3, envyUpgradePoint, markOfGoddess, sealedMark and spiritMark. Help only names Inspiration and Sin, so its broad exception sentence is a simplified description for this build.

The retained markOfGoddess row declares ResourceRegen:destiny:-1000, blessing:-1000 and fate:-1000; spiritMark declares+20% elemental regeneration. This establishes authored positive/negative retained effects, not a live rate measurement or full resource-effect installation audit.
failure_and_aftermath: Ordinary Gold, Destiny, Exp and Warrior/Sorcerer/Tamer points are explicitly non-carryover in the reviewed resource rows. A previously earned resource is not automatically retained.

Class proficiency/class talent accumulation are within-run retention, while class access and recorded routine completions have persistent carriers. Treating all three as one permanent multiplier would misdescribe the reset.

The complete _beforeReincarnationActions list, reset handler, SaveR constructor defaults, every replayed initialization action and save-file error/rollback behavior remain unreviewed. No claim of uninterrupted active-quest behavior is made from native code; that claim is installed-Help-only.
